title: Sparkly compass
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='disc' cx='50%' cy='45%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffffff'/>
      <stop offset='70%' stop-color='#dfe8f5'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#b9c8e0'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='ring' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffe9a8'/>
      <stop offset='50%' stop-color='#f5c542'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#c9962a'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='north' x1='0' y1='1' x2='0' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff8a7a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#e63329'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='south' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#8fb8ff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#3f6fd6'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- outer brass ring -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='34' fill='url(#ring)'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='29' fill='#8a6a1e'/>
  <!-- face -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='27' fill='url(#disc)'/>

  <!-- tick marks -->
  <g fill='#7a5a12'>
    <rect x='48.5' y='27' width='3' height='6' rx='1.2'/>
    <rect x='48.5' y='71' width='3' height='6' rx='1.2'/>
    <rect x='25' y='50.5' width='6' height='3' rx='1.2'/>
    <rect x='69' y='50.5' width='6' height='3' rx='1.2'/>
  </g>
  <g fill='#c9a240'>
    <rect x='62' y='30' width='3' height='4' rx='1' transform='rotate(45 63.5 32)'/>
    <rect x='35' y='30' width='3' height='4' rx='1' transform='rotate(-45 36.5 32)'/>
    <rect x='62' y='70' width='3' height='4' rx='1' transform='rotate(-45 63.5 72)'/>
    <rect x='35' y='70' width='3' height='4' rx='1' transform='rotate(45 36.5 72)'/>
  </g>

  <!-- needle: north (red) and south (blue) -->
  <polygon points='50,31 56,52 44,52' fill='url(#north)'/>
  <polygon points='50,73 56,52 44,52' fill='url(#south)'/>
  <!-- needle highlight edges -->
  <polygon points='50,31 50,52 44,52' fill='#ffb3a8' opacity='0.7'/>
  <polygon points='50,73 50,52 44,52' fill='#b9d2ff' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- pivot -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='4.5' fill='#f5c542'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='2.2' fill='#8a6a1e'/>
  <circle cx='49.2' cy='51.2' r='0.9' fill='#fff6d0'/>

  <!-- sparkles -->
  <g fill='#ffd94a'>
    <path d='M16 18 L18 24 L24 26 L18 28 L16 34 L14 28 L8 26 L14 24 Z'/>
    <path d='M84 20 L85.6 24.4 L90 26 L85.6 27.6 L84 32 L82.4 27.6 L78 26 L82.4 24.4 Z'/>
    <path d='M80 74 L81.4 77.6 L85 79 L81.4 80.4 L80 84 L78.6 80.4 L75 79 L78.6 77.6 Z'/>
    <path d='M18 70 L19.4 73.6 L23 75 L19.4 76.4 L18 80 L16.6 76.4 L13 75 L16.6 73.6 Z'/>
    <path d='M50 8 L51 11.4 L54.4 12.4 L51 13.4 L50 17 L49 13.4 L45.6 12.4 L49 11.4 Z'/>
  </g>
  <g fill='#fff3b0'>
    <circle cx='27' cy='24' r='1.6'/>
    <circle cx='73' cy='27' r='1.4'/>
    <circle cx='70' cy='80' r='1.5'/>
    <circle cx='28' cy='79' r='1.4'/>
    <circle cx='50' cy='91' r='1.6'/>
  </g>
</svg>
